subtitle: Two primer chapters citing outside sources through a research ledger
description: A fixture for check-provenance.sh and research-ledger.sh. Chapter 1 cites two ledger entries and links each where the reader meets the fact. Chapter 2 carries one of each citation failure: a mark citing an entry the ledger lacks, a link to a page the ledger does not hold, and a cited entry whose URL the chapter never links.
The ledger's domain is a placeholder, so nothing here is ever fetched. Entry 3 carries an operator-supplied copy of its page, which research-ledger.sh verify reads instead of fetching.
